question: Why do people often just stand and watch an approaching tsunami?
answer: A tsunami rarely looks like the wall of water seen in films. It looks like a tide rising, only very fast. From far away you can't sense its speed, so people stay and watch.
move: No wall doesn't mean no danger: a sea rising fast means run.
